news.body:
## Tomorrow's interview is the easy half
- The TLS slot becomes bookable the moment it ends.
Fitria put submission about two working days after the interview and the decision about fifteen days after that. Your board still says 23 October, and that is the version where your passport comes back around 7 November, the day you fly. Take the earliest slot TLS offers you, not the one that matches the board.
- Can you still get into TLScontact?
The activation link arrived on Sunday and nothing says you have used it. A login that does not work on Thursday costs exactly the days an early slot was meant to buy.
- Does SBI's in-principle offer need signing before it counts?
It came yesterday with an application form attached, which suggests the letter is not finished business. Proof of funds is a submission document, so it has to be in a form you can hand over this week, not in late October.

## The career track has a November problem
- Your first coaching session opens in the week you move.
The CDC wrote yesterday that coaches take 1:1s from early November, and that CareerLeader and Career Anchors must both be done first. That is the week you leave Jakarta and the week the KITAS expires, so the real window for two assessments worth fifty minutes is the next fortnight.
- Good job on the VMock upload on Sunday, 63 and into the yellow zone.
The SMART Editor is what takes it to green. Writing down your post-MBA function, industry and geography is still what the rest of this track is waiting on.
